scope: Theorem 2.2 (Subharmonicity of logarithmic profiles) of the manuscript “Sharp nodal length on smooth surfaces” (preprints/Sharp-nodal-length-on-smooth-surfaces-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1301138f44ca53ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On a fixed planar disk Ω, let real smooth functions Uj, pj satisfy ΔUj + K2 j pjUj = 0, where Kj ≥ 0. Let Sj > 0, Bj ∈ R2, and Dj = Sj + |Bj|. Assume Sj −→ ∞, Kj Dj −→ 0, sup j ∥pj∥∞ < ∞, K2 j ∥∇pj∥∞ SjDj −→ 0. (2.2) Local versions of the coefficient assumptions on relatively compact subdisks suffice. For positive constants cj, suppose the measures dμj = cje−2Bj·x |Uj(x)|2 dx have mass at most one on Ω. Every upper semicontinuous logarithmic profile with the compact, open, and weighted bounds of Lemma 2.1 is subharmonic on Ω, with the identically −∞ function allowed.
